title: You have no idea who’s been praying for someone like you.
paragraphs:
You have no idea who’s been praying for someone like you.
Your obedience, your kindness, your yes to God…
is the breakthrough someone else has been crying out for.
Step into the calling—your life is an answered prayer.
John 1:5 — “The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.”
